name: Sakamoto Ko'uta
source:
A homeroom teacher assigned to take care of the class full of problem children. She tries her hardest to be a responsible teacher, but possibly because the harsh reality hits her like a brick, there are times when she just feels like giving up. She is quite young, but her parents are worried about her marriage prospects.

[From [url=https://asa-pro.com/ousama/character/]official website[/url]]
